paragraphs.text: Pontotoc will host Caledonia at 7 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, at Tommy Morton Field, with both teams looking for their second Region 1-5A victory.
The Warriors enter the game 5–1 overall and 1–0 in region play. Caledonia is 3–3 overall and also 1–0 in the region, according to standings posted Thursday by Pontotoc Athletics.
Pontotoc, Caledonia and New Hope each won their region opener. New Hope is scheduled to visit Columbus, while Lafayette hosts West Point, the athletics department’s Oct. 15 standings graphic shows.
